proposal_boundary.purpose: One bounded synthetic HTTP cross-role handoff receipt on the exact dev9 source, conditional on a later explicit execution admission.

required_future_admission.decision_owner: Root integrator and owner of runtime/QA admission, followed by independent review of exact runner, fixture and raw result.
missing_permissions: Explicit same-problem UXD04 execution admission, with accounting against all historical attempts and a precise new budget if lawful.
Exact isolated disposable instance and synthetic fixture creation/read/write permission; old fixture 3/3 is exhausted.
Exact bounded HTTP/app runner, credentials, environment, test database and media paths, permitted operations and stop/cleanup rules.
Independent pre-execution review of final executable command/runner and final fixture manifest; this document is not that manifest.
Independent post-execution review of immutable raw outputs before any acceptance or integration claim.

synthetic_instance_contract_if_admitted.source: Exact immutable dev9 commit and file-hash manifest; abort on drift.
synthetic_instance_contract_if_admitted.database: New disposable isolated check_* database under approved verification settings; no historical or client data.
synthetic_instance_contract_if_admitted.media: Dedicated disposable BOS_TEST_MEDIA root outside live media; exact path and cleanup authorization belong in later manifest.
synthetic_instance_contract_if_admitted.clock: Pinned server as_of and a valid deadline on or after as_of; record both raw values.
synthetic_instance_contract_if_admitted.identity: Three separate authenticated sessions with CSRF where required: sender manager, recipient manager, denied observer. Record synthetic user and employee IDs, group/role and active state, without publishing credentials.
synthetic_instance_contract_if_admitted.membership: Sender Employee is current Task assignee in department A; recipient is active linked Employee in department B of type department; recipient User is active with exactly manager role. Observer has observer role and no write authority.
synthetic_instance_contract_if_admitted.source_fixture: One existing unarchived, unfinished Task with a current SalesOrder and at least one accumulated historical order/request reference, all visible to sender and recipient. Record exact source IDs, document access, pre-existing AuditEvent IDs, Task field snapshot and source_refs; no brochure or real data.
synthetic_instance_contract_if_admitted.fixture_authorization: NOT_GRANTED; existing fixture 3/3 cannot be reused as a new attempt.

candidate_sequence_if_admitted.operation: Fresh read of Task, sources and baseline Task/AuditEvent/ActionProposal IDs on the isolated fixture.
candidate_sequence_if_admitted.oracle: Sender sees same eligible Task and every accumulated source; capture exact pre-state and counts.

candidate_sequence_if_admitted.operation: POST /api/operations/preview/ with exactly action, task_id, assignee_id, expected_result, deadline, reason.
candidate_sequence_if_admitted.oracle: HTTP 200; proposal ID, payload and effect.operation=handoff identify same Task/recipient; Task and AuditEvent unchanged; proposal receipt null.

candidate_sequence_if_admitted.operation: Record explicit confirmation of the displayed preview; POST /api/operations/confirm/ with that proposal_id and confirmed=true in the same sender session before expiry.
candidate_sequence_if_admitted.oracle: HTTP 200 and state=succeeded; one unchanged Task ID now assigned to recipient, status active and selected deadline; receipt.task_id, receipt.audit_id, handoff.sender/recipient, expected_result and source_refs match fixture; one AuditEvent action=handoff_task, transition=handoff; proposal receipt persists with same IDs.

candidate_sequence_if_admitted.operation: Fresh independent recipient session/read: GET /api/tasks/?department_id=<recipient_department_id>, GET /api/tasks/<task_id>/, GET /api/tasks/<task_id>/history/ through all pages if required.
candidate_sequence_if_admitted.oracle: HTTP 200 for each; list and detail show same Task ID and current handoff, recipient assignee and expected_result distinct from preserved actual result; history contains exactly the S2 audit ID with sender actor, reason, before/after and handoff transition.

candidate_sequence_if_admitted.operation: Separate observer session attempts POST /api/operations/preview/ for the same Task and recipient.
candidate_sequence_if_admitted.oracle: HTTP 403 with error and without receipt/handoff/impact; Task, AuditEvent and successful proposal receipt unchanged.

candidate_sequence_if_admitted.operation: Replay POST /api/operations/confirm/ for the same successful proposal_id in its original session; then GET its task-proposal status.
candidate_sequence_if_admitted.oracle: HTTP 200; replay receipt equals S2 receipt; status state=succeeded and receipt matches; Task and AuditEvent counts/IDs unchanged, with exactly one handoff event for this proposal.

raw_evidence_contract: Immutable source commit/file hashes, exact reviewed runner and fixture hashes, instance/config identifier, server as_of, synthetic role-to-user/employee/department mapping.
Ordered raw request/response bytes or lossless bodies, status codes, headers necessary to prove session separation, and timestamps; redact only secrets with a documented reversible-free rule.
S0 and S1/S2/S4/S5 isolated Task, AuditEvent and ActionProposal snapshots with IDs and counts; recipient list/detail/history raw pages and pagination cursors.
Every operation's exit code, command identity, stdout/stderr, start/end time and evidence SHA-256; explicitly mark steps not run.
Independent reviewer checks source/instance/role attribution and raw evidence before any verdict.
stop_rules_if_admitted: Stop before fixture setup if admission, exact source, isolated paths, permissions or reviewed manifest is missing or drifted.
Stop on first unexpected status, missing oracle, leaked secret, ambiguous role/session, fixture collision or non-synthetic data; preserve raw output and counts, no automatic retry.
Stop if preview expires or a source/permission drift occurs; do not create a fresh proposal under this admission.
Never run full/PG/E2E, exhausted fixture/progress, C64, lifecycle or forbidden browser routes by changing tool, ID or branch.
A failed or partial receipt is NOT_PROVEN; no readiness or owner acceptance inference.
